stories.title: Top 10 free agent signings of the offseason
stories.summary: With the trade deadline approaching and training camp around the corner, here are the biggest free agent acquisitions that could change playoff races. Teams like the Eagles, 49ers, and Ravens made major moves to address key needs.

stories.title: Pro Bowl Game 2025 format changes
stories.summary: The NFL announced changes to the Pro Bowl format for 2025, moving away from the traditional game to skills competitions with team elements. Fans will have more ways to participate through voting and fantasy integration.

stories.title: 2024 NFL preseason Week 1 outlook
stories.summary: Preview of the first week of NFL preseason action with key storylines. Key storylines include quarterback competitions in several markets and the first look at rookie talent across the league.

stories.title: Tom Brady rumored to be considering a return to the league
stories.summary: Sources say Tom Brady is reportedly evaluating a return to the NFL this season. While nothing has been officially confirmed, the speculation has generated buzz across the league. Brady has not played since February 2022.

stories.title: Super Bowl LVIII championship recap
stories.summary: The Kansas City Chiefs made history by winning their second consecutive Super Bowl. Patrick Mahomes delivered another legendary performance, securing his third Super Bowl MVP award.

stories.title: Rookie quarterbacks shake up the Wild Card race
stories.summary: Three rookie quarterbacks have led their teams to unexpected playoff contention this season, defying pre-season projections and raising questions about NFL parity and development timelines.
